lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the production review phase closure driving one makeReviewDispatch round

nextStoryContext: SidecarOptions.runReviewPhaseFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts) is now wired end-to-end: buildReviewPhaseDeps resolves options.runReviewPhaseFn ?? makeProductionReviewPhaseFn(cwd, claudeDir, sessionName, logEvent, realSpawnFn), threaded into buildSidecarLoopDeps' return object and the final runSidecarLoop({ ...runReviewPhaseFn: deps.runReviewPhaseFn... }) opts bag, right after runShipPhaseFn (matching the loop.ts branch order established in US-003). makeProductionReviewPhaseFn mirrors makeProductionShipPhaseFn byte-for-byte in shape: wraps its whole body in try/catch/finally, builds ONE makeReviewDispatch(...) instance per invocation (own spawn/capturePane/readPrd/writePrd/isPaneAlive+ensureWorkerPane-via-makePlanPaneHelpers/readReviewReport+clearReviewReport/workerIsolation+preflightContainerFn+escalateFn-via-new-buildReviewContainerOpts), calls reviewDispatch(randomUUID()) exactly ONCE (no loop -- this is what makes 'one phase:review tick = one round' true by construction), narrates the ReviewDispatchResult via a new narrateReviewPhaseResult + makeNotifyOrchestrator, and ALWAYS resets phase to idle in the finally block (crash reason 'review-phase-crash', mirrors 'ship-phase-crash'). The reviewer backend is resolved entirely INSIDE makeReviewDispatch via readPhaseBackend('reviewer') (review.ts:354, pre-existing from CAM-349/350) -- makeProductionReviewPhaseFn does not call readPhaseBackend itself (verified by a source-text oracle asserting fnBody excludes the literal string). This is a SEPARATE makeReviewDispatch instance from host.ts's buildSupervisorOptions one (that one serves the per-story autonomous review dispatched from inside runSupervisor during the implement cycle; this one serves only the sidecar's standalone phase:review tick) -- do not try to unify them without re-reading both lifecycles first. sidecar.ts crossed its file-size ceiling (3471->3682, raised in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a dated _ref note, committed alongside). Tests: test/commands/sidecar.test.ts is a NEW file (the canonical mirror-source path for src/commands/sidecar.ts per the 'test/ mirrors source' convention -- previously nonexistent, sidecar tests were scattered under test/sidecar-*.test.ts and test/commands/sidecar-*.test.ts) covering AC1/AC3 via source-text oracles on makeProductionReviewPhaseFn's body (try/finally shape, exactly-one reviewDispatch call, no while/for wrapping it, no readPhaseBackend re-resolution, wires makeReadReviewReport/makeClearReviewReport); the loop.ts-level dispatch/crash-survival behavior (runReviewPhaseFn called once per review tick, absent on other phases, throwing survives) is already covered by US-003's 'runSidecarLoop — review-phase dispatch (US-003, CAM-403)' describe block in test/supervisor/loop.test.ts and was not duplicated. Next up (US-005): now that the sidecar-side production review dispatch exists end-to-end, it is safe to collapse templates/commands/cam-review.md to a thin phase:review signal-writer note (mirroring templates/commands/cam-ship.md) and drop subagent-reviewer from the orchestrator Task allowlist (templates/.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh + its .claude/ mirror, at three locations: header comment, case arm, error-message helper list) and from templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md's allowlist prose + in-context /cam-review Task flow description (and its .claude/ mirror). US-005 touches templates/ and vendor -- bun run embed-vendor then embed-vendor:check are mandatory gates, and dual-copy pairs are per-file NOT byte-identical (diff each templates/<->.claude/ pair before assuming a shared edit, per the cam-dual-copy-is-per-file pattern already in patterns.md).
